takeaways: Copilot only reflects the data it is grounded on, so cleaning a small, well-labelled slice of content before rollout prevents the first bad answers that destroy trust.
Adoption grows from visible wins, business champions and word of mouth, supported by simple frameworks such as ADKAR rather than heavy change-management decks.
Train with real, messy files in short sessions and sandboxes, set honest expectations, and keep a rollback plan for a failed launch.
hook: Messy, outdated data turns Copilot into a generator of confident nonsense, and users stop trusting it after the first bad answer. This episode is for IT and adoption leads planning or rescuing a Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout. Get ten practical actions, from cleaning your worst folder to champions, real-data training and a rollback plan.
